links.comparator_used: Same models without knowledge-base augmentation (DeepSeek-R1, DeepSeek-R1:8b, ChatGPT o3-mini-high alone)
links.effect: For DeepSeek-R1, knowledge-base augmentation significantly reduced accuracy by 4.36% (p=0.0002); no significant benefit was observed for the other models.
links.tradeoff: No consistent accuracy gain, and one model (DeepSeek-R1) lost accuracy with augmentation.
links.quote: Knowledge-base augmentation did not consistently improve performance; for DeepSeek-R1, it significantly reduced accuracy by 4.36% ( p=0.0002 ), while no significant benefit was observed for the other models.

links.comparator_used: Cloud-based DeepSeek-R1 (and ChatGPT o3-mini-high) accessed externally; the local model is a distilled 8B variant, so capability is not matched
links.outcome: First-attempt connection reliability versus diagnostic accuracy
links.effect: Local DeepSeek-R1:8b had a connection failure rate of 0.2% (95% CI 0.0%-0.5%) versus 4.6% for cloud DeepSeek-R1, but accuracy was 55.0% (95% CI 51.9%-58.5%) versus 89.5% for DeepSeek-R1 and 78.2% for o3-mini-high.
links.tradeoff: Much lower accuracy with the smaller local model, so the comparison is confounded by model size. Cloud DeepSeek-R1 also had longer latency (median 26.54 s).
links.quote: The locally deployed DeepSeek-R1:8b demonstrated markedly stronger connection reliability (failure rate 0.2%, 95% CI: 0.0%-0.5%) but substantially reduced accuracy (55.0%, 95% CI: 51.9%-58.5%).

design_hint: retrieval grounding (knowledge-base augmentation) and local vs cloud deployment mode
